title: Composable Selection Mode Toggles
description: Make lowpoly selection mode toggles (mesh, face, edge, vertex) composable instead of exclusive.
summary: Refactored lowpoly selection from exclusive `selectionMode` to composable `selectionTargets` (mesh/vertex/edge/face booleans) with multi-target selection stored as encoded pointer-focus keys. Toolbar uses `toggleSelectionKind` (puzzle2d pattern); at least one kind stays enabled. Canvas, marquee, gumball, and playground host now pass `selectionTargets` + `selectedTargets`; picking respects all enabled kinds with vertex > edge > face > mesh priority. Mesh commands (`flipFaces`, `markUvSeam`) filter by mode-specific ids. WASM/fixture schema extended with `targets` + `keys`; Rust tests and default fixture updated. All 12 Rust tests pass; WASM rebuilt.
